steps.command: bash -c ! grep -Eq "^\s*require|^\s*replace" go.mod && test -z "$(go list -deps -f "{{if not .Standard}}{{.ImportPath}}{{end}}" . | grep -v "^zeros3$")" && test ! -e vendor
bash -c env -u ZEROS3_C1_MODELS -u ZEROS3_C1_PQCHAIN go test -count=1 -json -timeout 120m ./... > /home/user/p8qual6/conventional_root.json
bash -c env -u ZEROS3_C1_MODELS -u ZEROS3_C1_PQCHAIN go test -race -count=1 -json -timeout 240m ./... > /home/user/p8qual6/conventional_race.json

bash -c set -o pipefail; /home/user/p8qual6/scratch/t1run -need-disk /home/user/p8qual6/scratch=13500 && TINY=900000 testing-harnesses/z4/c1/run_scale.sh /home/user/p8qual6/scratch/scale 100000 | tee /home/user/p8qual6/scale.txt
env ZEROS3_ZN7_WORKERS=1 ZEROS3_C1_MODELS=/home/user/p8models ZEROS3_C1_DECODE_BENCH=1 go test -count=1 -run TestAuthorityZN7DecodeScaling -v -timeout 60m .
env ZEROS3_ZN7_WORKERS=2 ZEROS3_C1_MODELS=/home/user/p8models ZEROS3_C1_DECODE_BENCH=1 go test -count=1 -run TestAuthorityZN7DecodeScaling -v -timeout 60m .
env ZEROS3_ZN7_WORKERS=4 ZEROS3_C1_MODELS=/home/user/p8models ZEROS3_C1_DECODE_BENCH=1 go test -count=1 -run TestAuthorityZN7DecodeScaling -v -timeout 60m .
